test_output_summary: All 58 tests passed (21 new logging tests, 7 config tests, 30 other existing tests). Logging module implemented with JsonFormatter, configure_logging function, get_log_level helper, and get_logger function.
implementation_notes: Implemented a comprehensive logging configuration module (src/core/logging.py) that includes: 1) JsonFormatter class for structured JSON logging with request_id/user_id support, 2) configure_logging function that sets up logging based on settings, 3) get_log_level helper to convert string levels to logging constants, 4) get_logger function for easy logger access. Integrated logging into the FastAPI lifespan to configure logging on startup. Updated tests verify all logging functionality including JSON/console formats, log level handling, and integration with settings.
